headline: Jimmy Kimmel Feels ‘Hormuzled’ by Trump’s New Deal With Iran
context: Although the agreement finally reopens the Strait of Hormuz, “we threw in a minimum of $300 billion,” Kimmel said. “Right now, Melania’s wondering, ‘How do I get a deal like that?’”
